items.title: Sam Kininger interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 27, 2011
items.q: I was checking out Cannonball, Coltrane, Parker, and all the other people who eventually — I guess you could say I’m a late bloomer when it comes to like jazz. I didn’t really focus on it until later on, like maybe a senior in high school and in college

ctx.x: I didn’t even know they did classical. © Fillius Jazz Archive -3-

Yeah, they have a symphonic — they call it symphonic orchestra, and which has everything, strings, brass, saxophones, everything. But it was definitely a transition because I was checking everything else out too at the same time I was checking out Cannonball, Coltrane, Parker, and all the other people who eventually — I guess you could say I’m a late bloomer when it comes to like jazz. I didn’t really focus on it until later on, like maybe a senior in high school and in college —where a lot of the kids I met grew…

Yeah. They might have come from one of those high schools that had an amazing program and a lot more bodies. Do you call yourself — let’s say you meet somebody that you don’t know, and they say what do you do. What’s your answer?
